name: Vitamin C Glow Serum
key_ingredients: Ethyl Ascorbic Acid 10%; Ferulic Acid; Licorice Root
how_to_use: Apply 3-4 drops on clean face every morning before moisturiser. Always follow with sunscreen.
cautions: Patch test first. May tingle slightly. Avoid using with retinol at the same time.
description: A lightweight brightening serum with 10% Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Ferulic Acid and Licorice Root extract. Fades dark spots & dullness. Suitable for normal, oily and combination skin. Fragrance free. Vegan.

name: Niacinamide 10% Clarifying Serum
concerns: dark spots; acne; pores; oil control
how_to_use: 2-3 drops AM and/or PM after cleansing.
description: Clarifying serum with 10% Niacinamide + 1% Zinc PCA. Controls oil, minimises pores, reduces acne marks. Best for oily & acne-prone skin. Non-comedogenic, fragrance-free, vegan.

name: Hyaluronic Hydra Serum
how_to_use: Apply on damp skin, morning and night.
description: Deep hydration with multi-weight Hyaluronic Acid and Panthenol (Vit B5). Plumps fine lines. For ALL skin types incl. sensitive skin. Vegan. Fragrance Free.

name: Gentle Retinol Night Serum
how_to_use: Use at NIGHT only, 2-3 times a week to start. Pea-sized amount.
cautions: Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Use sunscreen daily. Do not mix with Vitamin C or AHAs.
description: Beginner-friendly 0.3% encapsulated Retinol with Bakuchiol & Squalane. Targets fine lines, uneven texture. For normal, dry & combination skin. Not for sensitive skin.

name: Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50
how_to_use: Apply generously as the last step of AM routine. Reapply every 2-3 hours outdoors.
description: 100% mineral (Zinc Oxide) broad-spectrum SPF 50 PA++++. No white cast. Reef safe. Suitable for all skin types including sensitive skin. Fragrance free.

name: Tinted Sun Gel SPF 50
how_to_use: Apply two-finger amount before stepping out.
description: Tinted gel sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++ with Niacinamide and Iron Oxides - evens tone & protects from blue light. Best for oily and combination skin. Contains fragrance.

name: Ceramide Barrier Moisturiser
how_to_use: Massage onto face and neck AM & PM.
description: Rich moisturiser with 3 Ceramides, Cholesterol & Oat extract to repair the skin barrier. For dry, very dry & sensitive skin. Fragrance-free. Dermatologically tested.

name: Oil-Free Gel Moisturiser
how_to_use: Use morning and night after serum.
description: Oil free water-gel with Green Tea, Hyaluronic acid. Non-greasy, non comedogenic. Ideal for OILY & acne-prone skin.

name: Overnight Repair Night Cream
description: Night cream with Peptides, Shea Butter, Ceramides. Repairs while you sleep. Normal to dry skin.

name: Turmeric Foaming Face Wash
key_ingredients: Turmeric; Tea Tree Oil; Salicylic Acid 0.5%
how_to_use: Lather with water, massage 30 sec, rinse. Twice daily.
description: Gentle foaming cleanser with Turmeric, Tea Tree Oil & Salicylic Acid 0.5%. Removes oil and dirt without stripping. For oily, combination and acne-prone skin. SLS-free.

name: Green Tea Cleansing Oil
how_to_use: Massage onto DRY face, add water to emulsify, rinse. Follow with face wash.
description: Melts makeup & sunscreen. Green Tea, Jojoba & Sunflower oils. Emulsifies with water. Suitable for all skin types.

name: Matte Lip Tint - Rose
how_to_use: Swipe on lips; blend on cheeks with fingertip.
description: Transfer-proof matte lip & cheek tint, shade ROSE (cool pink). With Vitamin E. Lasts 8 hrs. Vegan, cruelty free.

name: Matte Lip Tint - Nude
how_to_use: Swipe on lips; blend on cheeks.
description: Transfer-proof matte lip & cheek tint, shade NUDE (warm beige-brown, suits medium to deep skin tones). With Vitamin E. Vegan.

name: Matte Lip Tint - Berry
description: Matte lip & cheek tint, shade BERRY (deep plum). Vitamin E. Long wear. Vegan, cruelty-free.

name: Beetroot Lip Balm
description: Tinted lip balm with Beetroot extract, Shea Butter and Kokum Butter. Heals dry, chapped lips. Natural pink tint.

name: Onion & Bhringraj Hair Oil
how_to_use: Massage into scalp, leave 1 hr or overnight, wash off with shampoo. 2-3 times a week.
description: Ayurvedic hair oil with Red Onion, Bhringraj, Amla & Coconut oil. Reduces hair fall and strengthens roots. For all hair types.

name: Rice Water Shampoo
description: Sulphate-free shampoo with fermented Rice Water and Keratin protein. For dull, frizzy and damaged hair. Colour safe.

name: Caffeine Under-Eye Cream
how_to_use: Gently dab a rice-grain amount around eyes AM & PM.
description: Under eye cream with 5% Caffeine, Peptides and Vitamin K. Reduces puffiness and dark circles. Suitable for all skin types. Fragrance free.

name: Glow Starter Kit
description: Kit with Vitamin C Glow Serum 30ml + Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 50g + Turmeric Foaming Face Wash 100ml. Complete morning routine for dull skin. Save 15%.

name: Kaolin Clay Mask
how_to_use: Apply thin layer, leave 10 min, rinse. 1-2 times a week.
cautions: Do not use on broken skin.
description: Detox mask with Kaolin & Bentonite clay, Niacinamide. Unclogs pores, controls excess oil. For oily and combination skin.
